subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad Anthropic signed-thinking replay issue stay open as the umbrella until prevention lands, or should maintainers make a narrower issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining tracker now that #92916 and #95430 are merged?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are implemented, but the remaining prevention path changes Anthropic thinking replay behavior and has multiple open candidate PRs with non-trivial compatibility and provider-routing risk.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to the narrower remaining issue and active prevention PRs.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat the landed recovery slices as the release-critical work and defer completed-turn thinking replay policy to a later provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already participated in the recovery-half discussion and is the best available routing candidate from the current related history.
